name: tigerstyle-lsp
description: A TigerStyle linter for Go, JavaScript, Odin, Python, Rust, TypeScript, and Zig

tigerstyle.arguments.description: The arguments passed to the server after the server subcommand.

tigerstyle.assertionsPerFunctionMin.description: The assertionsPerFunctionMin threshold, overriding the configuration file for this folder.

tigerstyle.configPath.description: A configuration file to read rather than discovering one.

tigerstyle.configurationPreference.description: The way the editor settings layer against the configuration file hierarchy.

tigerstyle.declarationDistanceMax.description: The declarationDistanceMax threshold, overriding the configuration file for this folder.

tigerstyle.elseIfChainMax.description: The elseIfChainMax threshold, overriding the configuration file for this folder.

tigerstyle.extendSelect.description: Turn on the rules these selectors name, beside the default set, for this folder.

tigerstyle.fixOnSave.description: Apply the safe fixes when a file is saved. The client must support workspace/applyEdit.

tigerstyle.functionLinesMax.description: The functionLinesMax threshold, overriding the configuration file for this folder.

tigerstyle.ignore.description: Turn off the rules these selectors name, for this folder.

tigerstyle.languages.description: The language identifiers the server is attached to.

tigerstyle.lineLengthMax.description: The lineLengthMax threshold, overriding the configuration file for this folder.

tigerstyle.logFile.description: A file the server writes its log to. The setting is accepted and recorded, but the server logs to standard error.

tigerstyle.logLevel.description: The level the server logs at. The setting is accepted and recorded, but the server logs each line it writes.

tigerstyle.nestingDepthMax.description: The nestingDepthMax threshold, overriding the configuration file for this folder.

tigerstyle.parametersMax.description: The parametersMax threshold, overriding the configuration file for this folder.

tigerstyle.preview.description: Turn on the rules still in preview, for this folder.

tigerstyle.select.description: Replace the default rule set with what these selectors name, for this folder.

tigerstyle.showNotifications.description: The condition on which the extension surfaces a server message.

tigerstyle.trace.server.description: Trace the traffic between the editor and the server.
